source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Clean gloves, tap water for periurethral cleansing, and a reusable lubricant container.","B":"Aseptic technique with sterile equipment, including sterile gloves, drape, sponges, appropriate solution, and single-use lubricant.","C":"Sterile gloves with permission for the catheter to touch clean bed linen if resistance occurs.","D":"Clean technique unless the client has recurrent urinary infection or major immunosuppression."}}
source_row.rationale: In acute-care hospitals, CDC recommends aseptic urinary-catheter insertion using sterile equipment. The recommended setup includes sterile gloves, drape and sponges, an appropriate antiseptic or sterile solution for periurethral cleaning, and a single-use lubricant packet.
source_row.source_detail: CDC CAUTI Summary of Recommendations — Proper Urinary Catheter Insertion / acute care: aseptic technique and sterile equipment including sterile gloves, drape, sponges, appropriate solution and single-use lubricant.
